faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in Punjab Vidhan Sabha Group D Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Punjab Vidhan Sabha Group D Recruitment 2026 has announced a total of 7 vacancies for Chowkidar and Safai Sewak posts.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in Punjab Vidhan Sabha Group D Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available posts are Chowkidar and Safai Sewak under Punjab Vidhan Sabha Secretariat Group D Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required for Punjab Vidhan Sabha Group D Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Chowkidar post should have passed 10th Class (Matric). Candidates should check the official notification for post-wise eligibility details.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Punjab Vidhan Sabha Group D Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 18 years and the maximum age limit is 37 years for Punjab Vidhan Sabha Group D Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of Punjab Vidhan Sabha Group D posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive salary under Level-1 Pay Matrix of Rs. 18,000 to Rs. 56,900 as per the 7th Pay Commission.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for Punjab Vidhan Sabha Group D Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process includes Punjabi Qualifying Test, Written Test and Skilled Test-cum-Interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to apply for Punjab Vidhan Sabha Group D Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 27 August 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application fee for Punjab Vidhan Sabha Group D Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 200/- for General/UR candidates and Rs. 100/- for SC/ST/BC and reserved category candidates of Punjab domicile. The payment can be made through online mode.
